Hi Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to hear how Peregrine is approaching clinical summaries and PHI handling during ingestion. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- What we heard: pilot scope = inference-only summaries for inpatient notes (50–100k tokens/day), data stays in your VPC, retention ~90 days for hot cache.
- Key asks from your side: evidence of controls (SOC 2), architecture diagram showing network boundaries, and a quick SE Q&A for the security team.

I attached the SOC 2 packet we discussed and a short architecture overview that highlights our VPC/private deployment options. Can you confirm whether the security team prefers a shared Drive link or a single ZIP via secure transfer?

Proposed next steps:
1) Security review (you) — any blockers or open questions by EOD Friday 9/18?
2) 20–30m technical sync (Ben CC'd) to run through the architecture and answer questions — availability windows next week?
3) If all green, Marissa (CC) can prepare a one-page pilot proposal and timeline.

Attachments: [redwood-soc2-packet-2026.pdf (PDF - 2.1MB)], [redwood-architecture-overview.pdf (PDF - 480KB)]

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the summary and the packet. I shared the SOC 2 bundle with our InfoSec lead and legal. A couple quick clarifying Qs from them: 

- Data retention in the private deployment: can we configure the hot cache retention to less than 90 days if needed?
- Do you have an auditable list of sub-processors / cloud regions used in the hosted flow (we might need it for the review matrix)?

Also, they asked whether you can provide a short network architecture PNG that highlights ingress egress points (the PDF is great, but they prefer a single-slide diagram for the tracker). If you can drop that in Drive, we’ll route it through our tracker and aim to get back by 9/18.

If it helps, Tom and I can host a quick 20-min sync with Ben next Tue (9/22) — let us know availability.

—Alyssa

- Hot cache retention: yes, retention is configurable per-customer — we can set to 30/60/90 days, and we also support manual TTL policies for specific datasets.
- Sub-processors/regions: attached is a short list and the Drive folder link with region metadata (AWS us-west-2, us-east-1 for failover).

I uploaded a single-slide PNG (redwood-arch-one-slide.png) to the Drive link below for your tracker. Ben is happy to take the 20-min sync and walk through anything technical. Marissa will follow up on pilot scoping after we have a technical green light.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD123-example
